def build_agent(sandbox):
    # Pivot at (12.0, 3.0) to allow the head to pass through the slot
    pivot_x, pivot_y = 12.0, 3.0
    # Arm length is 3.0m to reach x=15.0m at the slot
    arm_length = 3.0
    # Create horizontal arm
    arm = sandbox.add_beam(x=pivot_x, y=pivot_y, width=arm_length, height=0.26, angle=0.0, density=28.0)
    # Pivot joint at the pivot point
    sandbox.add_joint(arm, None, (pivot_x, pivot_y), type="pivot", enable_motor=True, motor_speed=0.0, max_motor_torque=2000.0)
    # Head at the end of the arm, positioned at x=15.0m (slot's x)
    head = sandbox.add_beam(x=pivot_x + arm_length, y=pivot_y, width=0.55, height=0.55, angle=0.0, density=85.0)
    # Rigid joint between arm and head
    sandbox.add_joint(arm, head, (pivot_x + arm_length, pivot_y), type="rigid")
    # Set material properties for collision response
    sandbox.set_material_properties(arm, restitution=0.2)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(head, restitution=0.2)
    # Check mass constraint
    mass = sandbox.get_structure_mass()
    if mass > sandbox.MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS:
        raise ValueError(f"Structure mass {mass:.2f} kg exceeds limit {sandbox.MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS} kg")
    return head
